risk_statement: Because privileged accounts lack phishing-resistant MFA, an attacker could take over an admin account, leading to ransomware and multi-day outage of core operations
current_controls: MFA via authenticator app for some admins
actions: Enforce FIDO2 for all admins; remove standing admin rights

risk_statement: Because backups are reachable from the production network and restores are untested, a ransomware attack could destroy backups, leading to recovery taking weeks instead of hours
actions: Immutable/offline copy; restore test of Tier 1 systems every 6 months
kri: % Tier 1 systems with restore test in 6 months

risk_statement: Because critical suppliers have not been assessed, a compromise at a supplier could expose customer data, leading to regulatory notification and contract breaches
actions: Tier suppliers; assess critical ones; add security clauses at renewal
